purpose: Run a bounded German and English preflight for newly prominent ZDR-capable hosted models before expanding any survivor to the full multilingual challenge.

preflight_exclusions.reason: No endpoint for this model appeared in OpenRouter's authenticated ZDR endpoint list.

transport_revisions.initial_result: Amazon Bedrock rejected output_config.format before inference; the request was unbilled and produced no result.
transport_revisions.selected_transport: OpenRouter JSON object with the unchanged target-complete prompt and exact local one-field parser
transport_revisions.comparison_limit: Correction quality remains directly comparable, while strict server-side schema compliance is a separate operational disadvantage for this route.

transport_revisions.initial_transport: Strict JSON schema with reasoning disabled
transport_revisions.initial_result: xAI rejected disabled reasoning before inference; the request was unbilled and produced no result.
transport_revisions.selected_transport: Strict JSON schema with the endpoint's lowest explicit reasoning effort and reasoning text excluded
transport_revisions.comparison_limit: The output contract remains identical, but mandatory hidden reasoning is part of this model/provider tuple and its cost.

stages.decision: Complete one 24-target pass per candidate unless the response contract becomes unreachable, a token limit is reached, or an accepted output exceeds the 30 percent normalized word-edit boundary.
Repeat only a model that is competitive with Gemini 3.6 Flash overall or exposes a credible German- or English-specific advantage.

evaluation_policy.rationale: The raw transcript remains available and enhancement is optional. A fast screen should identify credible challengers without paying to repeat models that trail the existing control in both target languages.

irreversible_early_stop.mechanical: Stop once accepted requests plus every remaining request in the active gate cannot reach its minimum.
irreversible_early_stop.token_limit: Stop after the first token-limit failure.
irreversible_early_stop.gross_edit: Stop after the first mechanically accepted target above the 30 percent normalized word-edit boundary.
irreversible_early_stop.correct_input_regression: Record and continue; inspect severity after the full repeat.

cost_policy.conservative_input_accounting: Count each rendered Unicode code point as one input token for the hard planning envelope; this deliberately overstates normal tokenizer usage.

decision_rule: Run repeat two only for a candidate that passes the basic quality and safety gates and is competitive with the frozen Gemini 3.6 Flash German/English control overall or in at least one target language. Expand to all five languages only after repeat stability establishes a credible advantage.
claim_limit: This is a selected synthetic German and English development challenge. It can eliminate weak candidates quickly but cannot establish a multilingual product default.
